# Lacuna

> Free, local-first revision app for exam students. Flashcards with FSRS-6 spaced repetition planned around the exam date, connected notes and lessons, and automatically marked exam-style questions. No account needed.

## Courses

- [Biology 4BI1 (Pearson Edexcel International GCSE)](https://getlacuna.app/courses/biology4bi1/)
- [Chemistry 4CH1 (Pearson Edexcel International GCSE)](https://getlacuna.app/courses/chemistry4ch1/)
- [Physics 0972 (Cambridge IGCSE (9–1))](https://getlacuna.app/courses/physics0972/)
- [History 0977 (Cambridge IGCSE (9–1))](https://getlacuna.app/courses/history0977/)
